create_signed_distance_field_from_mesh: create a SignedDistanceField from mesh vertices and triangles using mesh_to_sdf with voxel_size
extract_mesh_from_sdf: extract a quad mesh from a SignedDistanceField using dual_contouring with an isovalue
build_bvh_for_ray_tracing: build a TriBvh from mesh vertices and triangles and query closest_hit with ray origins and directions
fill_mesh_holes: fill holes in an incomplete mesh by calling fill_holes on vertices and triangles
save_load_sdf_msgpack: save a SignedDistanceField to a msgpack file and load it back with load_sdf_from_msgpack
